notes.title: New game! " World End Diner " Early access start!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/f983051adcb03e947be5aff51a56da3fef4e139d.jpg[/img]

Hello dear ones!
Today, I have a wonderful news for you.


I have started early access to new game!
Its name is "World End Diner".



This is a great simulation game where you run the world's last diner for the surviving animals and robots on the last island of the planet after humanity has died.

As the last robot to survive, you will create various dishes left by humankind and act them on cute forest animals and fragile robots!

As the last robot to survive, you will create various dishes left by humankind and sell them to cute forest animals and fragile robots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/afb57aaa76db5acdb974afa833754007db84508a.png[/img]

They are mainly dishes that are reminiscent of American diner.
Bacon scrambled eggs, burgers, pancakes, coffee, hot dogs, strawberry frappuccino, onion rings, mashed potatoes, potato pie, looks delicious!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/2b309f58f54bee39d7bea34cc2de00e898dfd0a0.png[/img]

And you are farming, exploring, and on the last island in the world.
Adventure In it, you may discover various past events on Earth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/c8f14cb9b858ba8c589e1024d9c5ba1a9c971e85.png[/img]

Cooking is not the only thing players can do.
We collect various materials and perform alchemy and crafting from them.

Build a diner facility to your liking and interact with various robots
Create your own best diner.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/bc5f4e26c816c8a8d94395180f11d9f122f155ae.jpg[/img]


This fun game, World End Diner, has started early access and will be updated from time to time.

I hope this game will be one of your wonderful summer memories.

Thank you.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1647190/World_End_Diner/

notes.title: Fully release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/0991f726afa269a29697e093edbc01896aef9ff8.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Finally, "Stress Explosion" has [b]full release[/b]!


It took about a month and a half from the early access start,
We were able to greatly expand the content.


The total number of stages has been increased from the original 16 stages to more than 40 stages.
In addition, various elements such as items, constructions, challenges, bonus areas, etc. have been added.

Also, I was able to create a very good story that I had never imagined at the beginning, and I was able to reach a wonderful ending!


We would like to thank all the users who played during the early period!


If you haven't tried this game yet, please enjoy this unique and fun game!

And if you like it, I can write a review so I can write a review as it can be a short sentence.


It's a full release, but we plan to update it little by little.

Now, I wish you a good game life!

notes.title: Update! 26th May,2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/cdc3f48b0476cde55ee1fbf4e12ad8a8e62918e3.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone!
How are you?
We are pleased to inform you that we have made a major update.


[h3] New "Area 4" added [/h3]

Finally, new area has been added!
The new area has a variety of stages that are different from the previous areas!


[h3] Added "Bonus stage" to Area 4 [/h3]

Like the previous bonus stages,
Bonus stages will appear as you build MAP structures.


[h3] Add ITEM to drugstore [/h3]

Added new items to Area 3 and Area 4 drugstores.
It will appear when you purchase all the items in the drug store.


[h3] Add treasure chests to various places [/h3]

Treasure chests have been newly installed in various places.
Please look for it!


[h3] Add Story-Ending [/h3]

The ending has also been added.
This is when you clear all area 4 and clear the bonus stage in area 4,
You can see.
Please try to reach the end of the story! !


Other small bugs are fixed.

Now, the period of early access is only one week left.
In the time left, I want to add as many elements as I can.



If you like it, please write a review on STEAM!
It is my great encouragement!

Thank you for playing this game!
See you soon!

notes.title: Early access start! 4th May,2020
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37492325/a899298279a28a085e4e59e8282d79f9723b53dc.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!
Early access to this strange game has begun!
Hooray!


Originally I was planning to start from 8 stages,

We were able to start early access with 16 stages, hidden elements and ranking functions implemented.

In the future, we will add more and more diverse and unique stages and fun elements.
Please look forward to it.


If you come up with an interesting idea of ​​a stress explosion situation,
Please feel free to post on the community bulletin board.
I read it all and use it as a reference for future development.


Also, if you find this game interesting,
If you like it, write a review and I'm so happy and happy!


see you soon!
